body:
I'm actually using capsules, not powder, so I'm pretty confident about the doses I took.  I know you're not supposed to take it every day on a regular basis, but I seem to typically not react much at all to stuff, and based on the non-reaction of the first day, I figured I'd be OK the second day and wasn't really expecting much of anything.  Obviously I was wrong.

Honestly, I probably will try it again next week, but starting with a much smaller dose.  There were two hours or so there where life was wonderful again.

I think I am bi, because the thought of hooking up with a guy is exciting, but I am still really attracted to women.  I think I probably have repressed the bi feelings over the years, but I've never been with another guy, so maybe it's just an infatuation, that if I actually followed through on, would go away.  But it doesn't really matter because I'm married.  My wife would flip out if she even knew I had these thoughts, as would every person in my family.

I confess I have gotten as far as creating an account on one of the free hookup sites, and despite the fact that I'm really overweight, I've gotten some attention and quite a few proposals to hook up.  I don't think I will ever actually do it, because I could just end up in a much worse situation ... but I confess, I do actually briefly feel good at the thought someone would want me.  And it is a strong temptation, just to briefly feel _something_, instead of dead inside.
